title: Opportunity
description: Potential revenue-generating event or sale to an account that needs to be tracked through the sales process to completion.

name.description: Subject or descriptive name (topic) for the opportunity.

description.description: Additional information to describe the opportunity.

estimatedvalue.description: Estimated revenue amount for the opportunity.

estimatedvalue_base.description: Estimated revenue converted to the system default base currency.

actualvalue.description: Actual revenue amount for the opportunity.

actualvalue_base.description: Actual revenue converted to the system default base currency.

budgetamount.description: Budget amount for the lead associated with the opportunity.

budgetamount_base.description: Budget amount converted to the system default base currency.

closeprobability.description: Likelihood of closing the opportunity, as a percentage.

estimatedclosedate.description: Expected closing date of the opportunity.

actualclosedate.description: Actual closing date of the opportunity.

stepname.description: Current phase in the sales pipeline.

salesstagecode.description: Sales stage code for backward compatibility.

opportunityratingcode.description: Rating indicating expected value based on revenue, status, and probability. Values: 1 (Hot), 2 (Warm), 3 (Cold).

budgetstatus.description: Budget status. Values: 0 (No Committed Budget), 1 (May Buy), 2 (Can Buy), 3 (Will Buy).

purchasetimeframe.description: Purchase timeframe. Values: 0 (Immediate), 1 (This Quarter), 2 (Next Quarter), 3 (This Year), 4 (Unknown).

timeline.description: When the opportunity is likely to close. Values: 0 (Immediate), 1 (This Quarter), 2 (Next Quarter), 3 (This Year), 4 (Not known).

customerneed.description: Customer requirements to identify products and services.

customerpainpoints.description: Customer pain points for product and service identification.

currentsituation.description: Notes about the current situation of the customer.

decisionmaker.description: Whether the contact is a decision maker.

developproposal.description: Whether a proposal has been developed.

completefinalproposal.description: Whether the final proposal is complete.

presentproposal.description: Whether the proposal has been presented.

presentfinalproposal.description: Whether the final proposal has been presented.

completeinternalreview.description: Whether the internal review is complete.

captureproposalfeedback.description: Whether proposal feedback has been captured.

totalamount.description: Total amount due, equal to sum of products plus discounts plus freight plus taxes.

totallineitemamount.description: Sum of all products included in the opportunity.

totaltax.description: Total tax amount on all products.

_parentaccountid_value.description: Parent account associated with this opportunity.

_parentcontactid_value.description: Parent contact associated with this opportunity.

_originatingleadid_value.description: Lead that the opportunity was created from.

_campaignid_value.description: Campaign that the opportunity was created from.

_modifiedby_value.description: User who last updated the record.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was last updated.
